pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry for Environment, Land and Sea Protection**of[Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italy)([Italian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_language):*Ministero dell'Ambiente e della Tutela del Territorio e del Mare*, also known as**MATTM**) was an Italian[ministry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(collective_executive))established in 1981. The ministry is responsible for[environmental issues](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Environmental_issues)in Italy. It was led by the[Minister of the Environment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_Minister_of_the_Environment). it was abolished in 2021, and replaced by the[Ministry of the Ecological Transition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_the_Ecological_Transition_(Italy)).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_of_the_Environment_(Italy)#cite_note-1)
